_note: Manifest for the tools/ layer — see docs/PLAN-practices-layer.md. Each entry's `schools` array names the school slugs (schools/<slug>/grammar.json) the tool practises; the relation lives here, not in the grammar, per CLAUDE.md's one-cross-link-pattern rule (no new grammar-side link field). needs_ai / needs_auth are both false for every tool in this Phase-1 pass — nothing here calls a model or requires sign-in. Entries with external_url are not yet hosted here — they live on outside platforms (claude.ai artifacts, a ChatGPT GPT, journal.recursive.eco) and are listed so the practices layer knows the full inventory; porting order lives in docs/PLAN-overflow-and-the-living-library.md.

tools.title: NVC Journaling
tools.blurb: A four-column self-empathy walk — what I feel and need, what I imagine you feel and need. Self-guided, no AI, nothing saved.

tools.title: Parental Love Bank
tools.blurb: A 15-minute check-in on the balance of what you ask from a child and what you give — deposits and withdrawals in a shared account of connection.

tools.title: Bagel Method — Perpetual Problems
tools.blurb: Distinguish the core of a perpetual problem from its flexible crust, per Gottman's finding that most couple conflicts are permanent and manageable rather than solvable.

tools.title: The Wheel of Life
tools.blurb: Rate the areas of your life on one wheel to see where attention is owed.

tools.title: Reframe a Thought
tools.blurb: Walk one upsetting moment from what happened, to what you feel, to what matters — cognitive reappraisal as a form.

tools.title: Best Possible Self
tools.blurb: A journaling space with research-backed prompts, on the project's own infrastructure.

tools.title: Stoic Self-Improvement Framework
tools.blurb: Who to be, rather than what to get — prohairesis as a daily practice. Reads naturally against the Stoic items in greek-pathe.
